milestones.title: Bound reviewer Chat history and retire rate-limited volumes
upgrade_prerequisites: Run the repository test suite, controller selftest, and release archive verifier.
Confirm the current candidate remains Alpha and Public Beta is blocked.
Confirm SuperLuna repository self-retests use superluna_repo_retest_v1 with the exact task-hash project and state paths.
Confirm generic-profile compatibility remains available for user-selected, host-authorized external projects.
Confirm browser read stays denied until the same waiting task is moved to and confirmed at the claim-expiry recovery RDATE.
Confirm submission recovery receives both current exact-URL counts and never navigates when one exact fixed Chat is already visible.
Confirm zero exact current-packet matches continues to the existing first-send authorization while one trusted match reconciles without resending.
Confirm every reviewer Chat is limited to eight formal reviews and the ninth submission is blocked before browser access.
Confirm a real submission rate limit permanently retires the old reviewer Chat, schedules one exact future recovery, and blocks early browser access.
Confirm cooldown recovery provisions exactly one replacement Chat with compact current context and never reopens, refreshes, probes, or scans the retired Chat.
rollback_triggers: A local validation result is presented as real-device or Beta evidence.
rollback_steps: Stop the current change and preserve the failing output.
Restore only the bounded milestone diff from the last verified commit.
Re-run the focused validator and the required local checks.
verification: A review packet whose visible Round N or 第 N 轮 title disagrees with the controller-owned round is rejected before browser submission.
Waiting reads pair only the complete assistant message after the current request, report fragments separately, and keep the fixed Chat tab for handoff.
Every authorized Chat action declares visible_foreground mode and denies background access.
Expected-failure mapping lines remain actionable while imperative external deletion remains blocked.
The milestone and release archive validators exit successfully.
Repository tests, selftest, and closure-check pass independently.
Two builds from the same source produce the same SHA-256 digest.
Local checks remain labelled as local-only evidence.
The packaged controller rejects repository-root, adjacent-run, symlink-escape, and external retest paths before any probe, state use, account gate, or browser access.
The tracked project sandbox configuration is documented as applying to newly started trusted-project tasks only.
An occurrence that exits after claiming but before reading can be recovered by the same one-shot wait after claim expiry, without a recurring or second scheduler.
A recovered unsent packet with zero exact visible matches reaches the existing one-shot send authorization without mutating state or inventing request identity.
A rate-limited reviewer identity cannot acquire startup, submission, waiting-read, or health-probe browser permission again.
Completing one rollover binds exactly one new canonical reviewer identity and resets the state-local formal round count.
A restarted browser with one visible exact fixed Chat reuses it without navigation, rejects ambiguity, and commits the new browser identity only after submission confirmation.
